outcome: Causes of Surgical Intensive Care Unit (SICU) admission
Length of stay in SICU and hospital
cohort: 50 obstetric patients admitted to the Surgical Intensive Care Unit (SICU) of King Khalid University Hospital, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, over a 5-year period
finding: The study found a very low SICU admission rate (0.267%) among obstetric patients with no mortality, suggesting good antenatal care, early admissions, and a multidisciplinary approach contributed to positive outcomes.
